mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_alarm_review_task ( w_id, review_type, media_url, prompt_snapshot, server_id, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{wId}, #{reviewType}, #{mediaUrl}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{serverId}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetries}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{startedTime}, #{finishedTime}, #{errorMessage}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, w_id, review_type, media_url, prompt_snapshot, server_id, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message, create_time, update_time FROM h_alarm_review_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h_alarm_review_task WHERE w_id = #{wId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

SELECT id, w_id, review_type, media_url, prompt_snapshot, server_id, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message, create_time, update_time FROM h_alarm_review_task WHERE (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < max_retries AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= #{now})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE h_alarm_review_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_time = #{startedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE h_alarm_review_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_time = #{startedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < max_retries AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= #{now}
UPDATE h_alarm_review_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', server_id = #{serverId}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, next_retry_time = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE h_alarm_review_task SET status = 'FAILED', server_id = #{serverId}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE h_alarm_review_task SET status = 'SKIPPED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, next_retry_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
